column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_shop.prx (runtime base 0x090ced00, shared slot: registry ids carry the
# rel_shop: prefix, addresses here do not); same columns as re/documented.tsv.

column3: Draws one booster of pack into out (cards_per_pack ids, rare-slot card last). Rarity box: the pack's 20 save entries minus the slots s16[4] at 0x090ef2fc (0,14,4,2) give the remaining rarities; rand % remaining picks r (1-3), stored with save_set_pack_entry(pack, 20 - remaining, r); a full box is cleared first. Rare slot from tier r falling back to lower tiers; commons from tier 0 (or the first non-empty tier) until full, redrawing invalid cards and cards already in the pack; packs 15 and 47 prefer unowned cards (50% rare slot, 30% commons). Random numbers from system_rand_shifted. Side effects: save rarity box, RNG state, heap (temporary lists). Caller: shop_open_next_pack.

column2: int shop_pack_has_card(short card, short * cards, uint count)
column3: 1 when card is among the first count entries of cards, else 0. No side effects. Caller: shop_draw_pack_cards.

Opens one pack of the current cart pack (shop state +0x10): shop_draw_pack_cards, then for each card fills a 0x60-byte display slot (+0x44 card, +0x46 index in fileTbl.dat, +0x48 pack) and counts the opened pack (+2); shop_record_opened_cards. Side effects: shop state, result list, save rarity box. Callers: shop_open_pack_step, shop_open_all_packs.

For every entry of the visit's result list (0x090faa74, 0x090faa7c entries of 10 bytes) calls save_change_card_count(card, 1) copies times: the only place where bought cards enter the collection. Side effects: save collection. Caller: shop_results_exit_step.

Appends the cards of the pack just opened to the result list: a card already listed for the same pack gets copies + 1 (up to 100), new ones are added (list grown by shop_grow_result_list) with copies 1 and counts from shop_fill_result_counts. Side effects: result list, heap. Caller: shop_open_next_pack.
Pack record byte 0 >> 2: 5, or 10 for pack 23. No side effects. Caller: shop_open_next_pack.
Unit price in DP, pack record +4. No side effects. Callers: shop_get_purchase_price, shop_buy_single_step, 0x090e09c4.

Packs per purchase mode: 0 -> 1, 1 -> the packs left on the current pack's shelf (both nibbles of 0x090f9bc0 + pack), 2 -> 20 (table s32[3] at 0x090ef2f0). No side effects. Callers: shop_get_purchase_price, shop_select_purchase_step, shop_buy_shelf_step, shop_buy_box_step.
shop_get_pack_price(pack) * shop_get_buy_quantity(mode). No side effects. Callers: shop_select_purchase_step, shop_buy_shelf_step, shop_buy_box_step.
Pack record +6, the clerk voice index (0-4). No side effects. Caller: shop_play_clerk_voice.

Pack record byte 0 bits 0-1 (sale state copied from the save by shop_load_pack_states; 2 = on sale). No side effects. Callers: shop_play_clerk_voice, 0x090df37c, 0x090e0128, 0x090e0370, 0x090cf578, shop_select_purchase_step, 0x090e09c4.
Percentage (0-100) of the cards of the four tier lists whose collection state (save_get_card_state) is not 0; 0 for an empty pack. No side effects. Caller: shop_load_pack_states.

shop_update_pack_unlocks, then for the 48 packs: sale state into record byte 0 bits 0-1, shop_get_pack_seen_percent into byte 1, the save shelf stock (save_get_pack_stock) into 0x090f9bc0 + pack. Side effects: pack table, shelf array, save pack states. Callers: 0x090d7470, 0x090cf31c, 0x090d7600.
save_set_pack_stock(p, shelf[p]) for the 48 packs. Side effects: save shelf stock. Callers: shop_results_exit_step, 0x090cf578.
Sum of the 48 per-pack cart counters u16 0x090f9afc[p] (packs bought in this visit and not yet opened). No side effects. Callers: shop_play_clerk_voice, 0x090cf578.
First pack index after pack with a non-zero cart counter, -1 when none. No side effects. Callers: 0x090d2318, shop_open_pack_step.
